static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends but struggling to build deep connections, often feeling Loneliness and isolation
static_traits.medical_history: Without major physical illness; never received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe experiences specifically; nervous at intake but fairly cooperative; Neutral attitude; tending toward Self-denial and pessimistic inference

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I cannot find someone willing to be with me, so I compensate for the lack of companionship by keeping many dogs. This belief causes me long-term Loneliness and isolation.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize Loneliness affects my mental health and overall well-being; I want to Learning how to build meaningful connections with others.
growth_experiences: Experienced a very difficult breakup a few years ago, since then long feeling Loneliness and isolation, believing oneself unable to build deeper connections with others; multiple failed attempts at dating and social activities gradually worsened the problem, Seeing couples or being in Social situations more easily triggers Loneliness and despair; mainly coping by throwing oneself into Work and keeping dogs company, but emotions still continuously affect Work performance, social life, and self-care.

core_beliefs: No one is willing to be with me
I am not good enough or not interesting enough, unable to make people stay long
I lack something others have (therefore destined to be unable to build intimate relationships)

special_situations.event: Sees couples or others paired up at social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no partner or deep connection, it means something is wrong with me and I am not worthy of love
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing social exposure, shifting attention to Work and keeping dogs company for self-soothing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find someone willing to be with me; I am missing something

special_situations.event: Looking back on multiple fruitless dating experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If attempts are unsuccessful, it proves I am destined to be unable to build intimate relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers openness and reduces further attempts to avoid being frustrated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This just proves I am not capable

special_situations.event: When realizing friends appreciate me and dogs give unconditional love
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only intimate connection with a partner counts as real connection; other positive relationships do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues existing positive connections to maintain existing beliefs
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These do not count as real connections

special_situations.event: When thinking about expressing Loneliness to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express Loneliness, They will think I am complaining and be unwilling to listen to me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids opening up to friends and seeking help, choosing to bear it alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am complaining

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to build stable, deep intimate relationships and to be accepted and accompanied
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, negated, and failing again, being seen by others as 'complaining' or 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected by keeping some distance and reducing self-disclosure
Replacing interpersonal intimacy with Work and dogs' companionship for Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: I am Loneliness, not good enough, and hard to be accepted long-term
object_relations.object_representation: Others are paired up, people who may criticize or reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing couples in social settings or when intimate relationship topics are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fang Jie interprets others' intimate situations as her own failure, believing 'flawed, destined to be unable to build intimate relationships' (transference: self-deprecation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use self-blaming and negating language, emphasizing one's shortcomings and failure experiences; low tone, reduced eye contact and detail.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When considering expressing Loneliness to friends or being invited to be more open in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fang Jie tends to think others will see her as 'complaining' and be unwilling to Listening (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Polite but avoidant of disclosure, using vague language and Displacing topics, downplaying feelings, shortening response length.

manifestations: Living alone and keeping 4 dogs company to make up for the lack of companionship
Long feeling unable to build deep connections with people since the breakup
Strongly feeling out of place and Loneliness when Seeing couples or Attending social activities
Has a few friends but finds it hard to open up to them
outcomes: Persistent Loneliness and sense of isolation
Social avoidance, difficulty building intimate relationships
Work performance affected, social life and self-care impaired

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believes friends will see them as complaining, thus avoids opening up
Presetting others' negative views of oneself before social interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Not expressing Loneliness and needs to friends, choosing to bear it alone
Displacing and self-soothing by throwing oneself into Work and keeping dogs company rather than seeking human support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Self-denial (such as 'I am not good enough/not interesting enough') leading to Social withdrawal
Excessively cares about others' opinions in social settings, thus reducing self-exposure and interaction

positive_force: Love for dogs bringing stable emotional support and potential social cues
Still keeps several friends' support and appreciation
Willing to seek help and try new perspectives and behavioral experiments
Has engagement and creativity in photography work
negative_force: Cognitive distortions of overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating the positive
Fearing Being rejected, finding it hard to open up to friends and express needs
Low sense of self-worth, tending toward self-blame and despair
Social avoidance, Seeing couples triggers a strong sense of hopelessness

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and difficulty opening up to others
antecedent: Feeling out of place when Seeing couples or Attending social activities
When considering talking to friends about Loneliness
target_behavior.core_reason: Forming the belief 'no one is willing to be with me/I am not good enough' and Fear of Being rejected after the breakup, accompanied by cognitive distortions of overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating the positive.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of Being rejected and evaluated, maintaining short-term security and emotional stability
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Loneliness and isolation, difficulty building deep relationships, Work, social life, and self-care affected

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and despair (such as 'I will never find a partner' 'I am not good enough')
antecedent: Reflecting on past failed relationships when Being alone
When seeing others in pairs at social events
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing past failure experiences into 'I am destined to never find a partner', and negatively mind-reading others' thoughts, forming a stable negative core belief.
target_behavior.function: Lowering expectations through Self-deprecation to prevent frustration, temporarily reducing Anxiety and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Decreased drive, further Reduced socializing and dating attempts, the problem cycle worsening
